topic.title: Are the publicly released GLACIER weights trained on MassSpecGym eligible for a prize-eligible solution?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: The weights are publicly released by the official coleygroup/ms-pred repository as open-source MassSpecGym-trained GLACIER weights, and are separate from the NIST-trained checkpoints that require a NIST license. Repository: https://github.com/coleygroup/ms-pred Could the organizers confirm that these MassSpecGym-trained GLACIER weights are compatible with the competition’s commercial-use / redistribution requirements?

comments.content: Based on the hosts previous answer , i dont see why not. MassSpecGym is allowed so is any model derived from that. https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/enveda-CASMI26-molecule-id-mass-spectra/discussion/742991#3527946
Yes, MassSpecGym is allowed, so is GLACIER
